request: Iterate with Luna, use the additional training data and prior experiments, seek feed_like_v2 spell F1 strictly above 0.60 without other metric regressions.

development.aggregation: realizations within match, matches within provider, equal provider means
development.exposure: Previously selected-on development matches; synthetic v2 uses state-conditioned corruption calibrated from historical model predictions. No independent confirmation claim.

success.retention: Each aggregate quality metric on clean, v1 and v2 must be >= matched adopted control, with zero tolerance. Report all failures and provider diagnostics.
success.ranking: v2 spell F1 descending; macro F1 for exact ties

One separately declared combination follow-up informed by completed rounds; freeze exact arms and artifacts before scoring

data: Use verified original-provider TRAIN sources and the archived 45-game SoccerNet-GAR TRAIN dense silver-label corpus. Reuse of this additional corpus does not create new independent labels or matches. Preserve every held-out provider in teachers, checkpoints, normalization and training inputs.
guards: Replay adopted controls before candidate scoring
Freeze sources, input hashes, arms and budgets separately before each round
Keep failed outcomes and declarations immutable

delivery: Commit code, aggregate evidence, limitations and verification; publish a PR and update the existing restricted research site. Native arrays and model weights stay ignored/local unless separately authorized for upload.
